name: Chinese Evergreen
hook: Chinese evergreen struggling? It hates the cold.

steps.title: Low to medium light
steps.tip: Plain green types handle low light; patterned ones need brighter, indirect light. Keep sun off the leaves.

steps.title: Water when 2–5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Keep it moist but not soggy, using room-temperature water. In winter, let it dry more between waterings.

steps.title: Keep it warm
steps.tip: It's best at 20–27°C by day. Below 10°C it gets chill damage, so keep it away from cold drafts.

steps.title: Room humidity is fine
steps.tip: Average indoor air suits it. Very dry air or a drafty spot can turn the leaves brown.

steps.title: Check for mealybugs
steps.tip: Look for mealybugs, scale, aphids and mites. A soggy, slow-draining mix leads to root rot.

outro: Warm, evenly moist and out of the sun: an easy plant for dim rooms.
